summary: The note-candidates cadence is now a config key, [notes] candidates_interval_seconds (default 3600, minimum 300); the operator sets it to 10800 for every 3 hours.
details: A longer interval defers messages rather than dropping them: each fire reads at most 80 messages past the watermark and advances it by what it read.
limitations: A room speaking more than 80 messages per interval builds a backlog that drains at 80 per interval, oldest first.
